turns.text: Good to see you again. Where would you like to start today?
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I am still keeping wine to the weekend and last Saturday I only had one glass.
What went through your mind then?
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment.
Take your time.
I dreamt about my grandfather in the mine and woke up with my heart racing.
How did that feel for you?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
Tell me more about that.
Dad fell in the kitchen on Thursday and bruised his hip, thank God nothing was broken.
What went through your mind then?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I asked Linda if I could move to a four-day week, she is checking with the director.
What went through your mind then?
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while. I keep coming back to it.
Let us stop here for today.
Thank you, see you next week.
